theme_central: Man created in the finest form, then brought down to the lowest of the low, except those who believe and do good — is Allah not the most just of judges?

branches.title: Oaths by the sacred places
branches.resume: Oath by the fig, the olive, Mount Sinai, the secure City (Mecca).

children.t: Oaths by the fig, the olive, Sinai, the secure City

branches.title: Man, perfect form and decline
branches.resume: Man created in the finest form, brought down to the lowest of the low, except the believing doers of good.

children.t: Man's perfect form, decline except for the believing doers of good

branches.title: Closing
branches.resume: What then makes you deny the Judgment? Is Allah not the most just of judges?

children.t: Allah, the most just of judges, argumentative closing
